# foreman_templateinput (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foreman_templateinput" "os_major_version" {
  name       = "os_major_version"
  input_type = "user"

  description = "The operating system major version to provision"
  required    = true
  default     = "9"
  options     = ["7", "8", "9"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input_type` (String) Input type
- `name` (String) Input name

### Optional

- `advanced` (Boolean) Input is advanced
- `default` (String) Default value for user input
- `description` (String) Input description
- `fact_name` (String) Fact name, used when input type is Fact value
- `hidden_value` (Boolean) The value contains sensitive information and shouldn not be normally visible, useful e.g. for passwords
- `options` (List of String) Selectable values for user inputs
- `required` (Boolean) Input is required
- `resource_type` (String) For values of type search, this is the resource the value searches in
- `value_type` (String) Value type, defaults to plain
- `variable_name` (String) Variable name, used when input type is Variable

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_templateinput.os_major_version <templateinput_id>
```
